note: One source, read by the app and by the docs. Nothing in 8.6 is rebound. There is no d, and Enter stays promote. A key whose built flag is false answers that it is not built in this slice and records nothing. Since slice 3 (amendments 9.16 and 9.17) every key is built: a single-key act is queued ten seconds and Backspace cancels it; the Merge Sheet commits on its own button.
